question: How do I authenticate requests to the Fern API?
ground_truth: To authenticate requests to the Fern API, you need to use a bearer token. You can generate this token using the CLI command `fern token`. The tokens do not expire once generated.

metadata.cited_context: Fern API requests require a bearer token for authentication. Use the CLI command [`fern token`](/learn/cli-api/cli-reference/commands#fern-token) to generate a bearer token. Tokens do not expire.
